_meta.note: All codepoints are U+0000–U+FFFF (BMP). X/twitter-text counts each as 1 weighted character.

categories.label: CJK Brackets & Punctuation
categories.description: Japanese/CJK typographic enclosure marks — the user's exemplar aesthetic (「 」)
categories.rendering_notes: Near-universal coverage. All are BMP. No emoji dual-presentation risk.

categories.label: Half-Width Katakana
categories.description: Narrow-width katakana for terminal/HUD readout aesthetic (ｶﾀｶﾅ)
source_blocks: Halfwidth and Fullwidth Forms (U+FF00–U+FFEF), range FF61–FF9F
categories.rendering_notes: Requires CJK-capable font (Noto Sans CJK, MS Gothic, etc). Missing on Latin-only system fonts. U+FF9E and U+FF9F are spacing/combining marks.

categories.label: Box Drawing & Block Elements
